metadata.title: [BUG]: OAuth callback "Fetch Tools" button broken due to CSP regression
metadata.author: bogdanmariusc10

description: ### 🐞 Bug Summary After completing OAuth authorization for MCP servers (Notion, ClickUp, Gamma, Granola), the "Fetch Tools from MCP Server" button on the OAuth success page fails silently. Browser console shows CSP violations and `ReferenceError: Can't find variable: fetchTools`. --- ### 🧩 Affected Component - [x] `mcpgateway` - UI (admin panel) - [x] `mcpgateway` - API (OAuth callback endpoint) **Specific file:** [`mcpgateway/routers/oauth_router.py:686-726`](mcpgateway/routers/oauth_router.py:686-726) --- ### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce 1. Configure an OAuth-enabled MCP gateway (e.g., Notion): ```bash POST /gateways { "name": "notion-mcp", "url": "https://mcp.notion.com/mcp", "transport": "SSE", "auth_type": "oauth", "oauth_config": { "grant_type": "authorization_code", "client_id": "...", "client_secret": "...", "authorization_url": "https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize", "token_url": "https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token", "redirect_uri": "https://your-domain/oauth/callback", "token_endpoint_auth_method": "client_secret_basic" } } ``` 2. Navigate to the gateway in Admin UI and click "Authorize" 3. Complete OAuth flow in Notion (or other service) 4. Get redirected to OAuth success page showing: ``` ✅ OAuth Authorization Successful Gateway: Notion User ID: quwlZAXybXkVNNA8 [🔧 Fetch Tools from MCP Server] button ``` 5. Open browser DevTools Console (F12) 6. Click the "Fetch Tools from MCP Server" button --- ### 🤔 Expected Behavior - Button click should trigger `fetchTools()` function - Function should POST to `/oauth/fetch-tools/{gateway_id}` - Tools should be fetched from the MCP server - Success message should appear - User should be able to use the tools --- ### 📓 Logs / Error Output **Browser Console Errors:** ``` Refused to execute a script because its hash, its nonce, or 'unsafe-inline' does not appear in the script-src directive of the Content Security Policy. ReferenceError: Can't find variable: fetchTools ``` **HTML Source (from OAuth callback response):** ```html ``` --- ### 🧠 Environment Info | Key | Value | |-----|-------| | Version or commit | `main` (post PR #4424, #4673) | | Runtime | Python 3.11+ | | Platform / OS | macOS / Linux | | Container | N/A | | Relevant PRs | #4424 (nonce-based CSP), #4673 (event delegation) | --- ### 🧩 Additional Context **Root Cause:** Recent CSP hardening PRs (#4424, #4673) removed `'unsafe-inline'` from the `script-src` directive and migrated 273 inline event handlers to the `data-action-*` event delegation pattern. However, the OAuth callback success page at [`oauth_router.py:686-726`](mcpgateway/routers/oauth_router.py:686-726) was **missed in the migration** because it's dynamically generated in Python code rather than a `.html` template file. **Two CSP violations:** 1. **Inline ` # Replace onclick with data-action
